module_summary: src/dash_browser.c is the dashboard File Browser: worker-thread folder listing with sort/view modes, the device root list, opening/launching files, classic file operations (copy/paste/PSU/delete/rename/size/title.cfg/VMC mount/folder icon/folder dates/bookmarks) wrapped in dashboard dialogs, and a large set of memory-card and MMCE tools (active-card history backup, PCSX2 export/import, recovery, install as new MMCE card). It is driven as the Files tab (dashFilesScreen) of dash_main.c; the old modal entry dashFileBrowser() is no longer called. Card image work delegates to mc_card_export.c and mmce_backup.c, but the active-card history logic re-implements helpers that mmce_backup.c already has.

reusable_helpers.name: wrapIndex
reusable_helpers.what: wraps a list index into 0..total-1 (cursor wrap-around)

reusable_helpers.name: pageIndex
reusable_helpers.what: page up/down that stops at the list ends before wrapping

reusable_helpers.name: parentOf
reusable_helpers.what: splits a device path into parent folder and last component

reusable_helpers.name: joinBackupPath
reusable_helpers.what: joins folder + name, adding '/' unless folder ends in '/' or ':'

reusable_helpers.name: activeBackupStamp
reusable_helpers.what: YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS local-time stamp from the PS2 RTC with Timer() fallback

reusable_helpers.name: activeHistoryFilesEqual
reusable_helpers.what: byte-compares two files in 16 KB chunks

reusable_helpers.name: fmtSize
reusable_helpers.what: formats a byte count as GB/MB/KB/B

reusable_helpers.name: gameIdFromImageName
reusable_helpers.what: extracts a validated Game ID from <ID>.mcd or <ID>-1.mcd

reusable_helpers.name: browserDisplayPath
reusable_helpers.what: shows usbN: paths as massN: for display

findings.title: Eight static int[MAX_ENTRY] scratch arrays (64 KB .bss) where one shared array is enough
findings.problem: opCopy, opExtractPsuTo, opImportSavesTo, opDelete, opSize and actionsMenu (three times: sv_idx, psu_idx and a second sv_idx shadowing the first inside case F_IMPORT_SAVES) each own a static int[MAX_ENTRY] (MAX_ENTRY = 2048, 8 KB each). All run on the UI thread, none is re-entered while another is in use, and actionsMenu only uses its arrays for counts before dispatching, so one array would do. The F_IMPORT_SAVES case also recomputes saveFileTargets that actionsMenu already computed at 2810.
findings.fix: Replace the eight function-local static arrays with one file-scope static int[MAX_ENTRY] used by targets() callers; in case F_IMPORT_SAVES reuse it instead of declaring another sv_idx.
findings.benefit: 57,344 bytes of .bss freed (MEASURED: 8 symbols of 8192 bytes each in evidence/Launchstation/raw/sizes/wLaunchELF-unstripped-all-symbols-by-size.tsv: opCopy.idx, opExtractPsuTo.idx, opImportSavesTo.idx, opDelete.idx, opSize.idx, actionsMenu.sv_idx, actionsMenu.psu_idx, actionsMenu.sv_idx.228; 7 x 8192 saved)
findings.evidence: grep -n 'static int .*\[MAX_ENTRY\]' src/dash_browser.c: lines 822, 978, 1054, 1079, 1172, 2698, 2795, 3045. MAX_ENTRY = 2048 at include/launchelf.h:205. Symbol table sizes TSV lists all eight as 8192-byte LOCAL .bss objects. Read all users: each fills its array via targets()/psuTargets()/saveFileTargets()/ps1SaveTargets() and consumes it before returning; actionsMenu reads psu_idx/sv_idx only for counts (2796, 2810, 2880) before the switch at 2927, and the op functions called from the switch do not return into code that reads the old contents.

findings.title: Active MMCE card history helpers re-implement mmce_backup.c (stamp, join, newest, compare, prune) with 32 KB of extra buffers
findings.problem: dashBcdToInt+activeBackupStamp (1257-1288) are a line-for-line copy of mmce_backup.c bcd_to_int+backup_stamp (45-71); joinBackupPath (1304-1314) copies join_path (73-83); activeHistoryNewestOther copies newest_history (136-164) with a different name prefix; activeHistoryFilesEqual copies files_equal_serial (376-395) with its own 2 x 16 KB static buffers; activeHistoryScan+activeHistoryPrune redo prune_history (437-484); activeStampedName redoes unique_history_path (486-517). activeHistoryName is a one-line forwarder with one caller (1569). The 4-line BCD helper also exists in dash_card_tool.c, main_history.c and main_title.c.
findings.fix: Export backup_stamp, join_path and files_equal_serial from mmce_backup.c and give history_name_match/newest_history/prune_history/unique_history_path a name-prefix parameter ("WLE-" vs "MMCE<n>-ActiveCard-"); delete dash_browser.c 1257-1466 except a few lines of glue. Keep one BCD helper (exported from mmce_backup.c or main_title.c) for the other copies.
findings.benefit: ~150 lines removed (INFERRED: 210 lines at 1257-1466 minus ~25 lines of glue and parameter changes) and 32,768 bytes .bss (MEASURED: activeHistoryFilesEqual.buf_a and buf_b, 16,384 each, BUILD-EVIDENCE.md top-symbol list)
findings.evidence: Read dash_browser.c 1257-1466 and mmce_backup.c 45-83, 125-164, 376-395, 437-517; the stamp, join, newest and compare bodies match apart from names and the prefix test. grep -rn '>> 4) \* 10' src: dash_browser.c:1259, dash_card_tool.c:1375, main_history.c:24, main_title.c:48, mmce_backup.c:47. Callers of the dash_browser copies are only opBackupActiveMmce (1569-1606) and opExportActiveMmcePcsx2 (1640-1641). Risk High because prune deletes history files. files_equal_serial reopens the file per chunk (read_chunk), slower but uses buffers that already exist; worker is idle after prepareOp (INFERRED no concurrent user of compare_a/compare_b).

findings.title: Modal dashFileBrowser() and browserScene() are never called; modal-only branches remain in the tab code
findings.problem: dashFileBrowser has no caller (only its definition and the prototype at dash_internal.h:1112) and the linker discards it and browserScene. Since browserDrawBody is then only reached through browserTabDraw with fb_tab_active == 1, every !fb_tab_active branch is unreachable, and browserProcessInput is only called with running == NULL, so every running branch is dead. The comment at 86-87 still says the modal browser serves Tools / launch-key callers.
findings.fix: Delete dashFileBrowser, browserScene and the prototype; drop the running parameter (fold browserProcessInput into browserTabInput) and the fb_tab_active ternaries/conditions in browserDrawBody; fix the comment at 86-87. tests/test_files_tab_lifecycle.py:28-32 assert on the modal code and must be updated.
findings.benefit: ~60 lines removed; dashFileBrowser (496 B) and browserScene (60 B) are already discarded by --gc-sections (MEASURED, raw/link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv), the dead branches in live functions are a few hundred bytes of .text (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep -rnw dashFileBrowser over src include tests *.S *.yaml: dash_internal.h:1112 (prototype), dash_browser.c:3631 (definition), tests only assert it is NOT called from dash_main. wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv lines 23-24: .text.dashFileBrowser 496, .text.browserScene 60. grep fb_tab_active/running in dash_browser.c: browserDrawBody is called only from browserTabDraw (guarded by fb_tab_active) and browserScene; browserProcessInput only from browserTabInput (NULL) and dashFileBrowser (&running).

findings.title: Leftover 'temporary hardware diagnostic' PAD status overlay on USB folders
findings.problem: browserDrawBody prints raw pad DMA state, request state, IOP reset generation and worker-busy flag under every USB listing; the comment calls it a temporary diagnostic for an already completed USB input-loss report (commit 110be3f). browserSnapshotPad polls padGetState/padGetReqState every frame in the Files tab only to feed it, and fb.pad_* fields exist only for it. No test references it.
findings.fix: Delete the overlay block, browserSnapshotPad and its two calls, and the pad_state/pad_request/pad_generation/pad_snapshot_valid fields.
findings.benefit: ~27 lines removed, one per-frame pad state read pair and one snprintf per frame on USB folders gone; small .text saving (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep -n 'fb.pad_\|pad_snapshot_valid\|pad_generation\|browserSnapshotPad' over the repo: only dash_browser.c 56-58, 3396-3400, 3457-3467, 3560, 3653; grep tests for browserSnapshotPad/pad_snapshot_valid/'PAD 0:': no match. git log -S 'Temporary hardware diagnostic': 110be3f 'diagnostic: expose pad DMA states after USB directory completion'.

findings.title: prepareTransferDeviceStacks check and warning block repeated 9 times
findings.problem: Every card operation calls prepareTransferDeviceStacks and then shows a modal with one of two near-identical texts (incompatible stacks / device not started), each written out again with slightly different wording, 8-9 lines per site.
findings.fix: Add one static helper that runs prepareTransferDeviceStacks(source, dest), shows the modal with a caller-supplied title and the standard two texts, and returns 0/1; replace the nine blocks with one-line calls.
findings.justification: The same 8-9 line block appears nine times in this file; a ~12-line helper replaces ~72 lines, a net removal of ~45 lines and one set of message strings.
findings.benefit: ~45 lines removed net (INFERRED: 9 x 8 lines minus 9 call lines minus ~12-line helper) and a few hundred bytes of duplicate strings (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep -c 'TRANSFER_STACK_INCOMPATIBLE ?' src/dash_browser.c = 9 (only file with this pattern); read each block at the cited ranges; they differ only in title and wording.

findings.title: mmceImportCandidate duplicates recoveryTargetPath and re-checks what its single caller guarantees
findings.problem: mmceImportCandidate is recoveryTargetPath without the USB/HDD prefix test: the same RECOVER-%03d.mcd + .PART free-name loop. It also rebuilds the folder string its only caller already built at 1923, and both it and mmceSelectableCandidate check unit range and NULL/size arguments that their single callers (stack arrays, unit from a 2-entry choice) cannot violate.
findings.fix: Move the USB/HDD prefix test from recoveryTargetPath into recoverCardFromPath, call recoveryTargetPath(folder, ...) from opImportCardToMmce and delete mmceImportCandidate; drop the impossible argument checks in mmceSelectableCandidate. tests/test_mmce_native_import.py exercises mmceImportCandidate and must follow.
findings.benefit: ~28 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges)
findings.evidence: Read 1813-1865, 1919-1968, 1994-2019. mmceImportCandidate callers: only 1963; mmceSelectableCandidate: only 2145; recoveryTargetPath: only 2244. Folder at 1850 equals the one built at 1923.

findings.title: Repeated device-prefix tests and option table: mc/vmc test x10, USB/HDD test x4, mc0/mc1 test x3, slots[] x2
findings.problem: actionsMenu evaluates strncmp(fb.dir,"mc",2) && strncmp(fb.dir,"vmc",3) eight times on the same fb.dir, including two consecutive identical ifs at 2821 and 2823. The mass/usb/ata/hdd prefix test is written out four times, the mc0:/mc1: test three times, and the two-entry MMCE slots[] table twice.
findings.fix: In actionsMenu compute the off-card flag once and merge the ifs at 2821/2823; add one static isExternalStore(path) for the four USB/HDD tests; move slots[] to file scope.
findings.justification: isExternalStore replaces four 2-3 line conditions with calls; the flag and file-scope table remove repeated code without adding behaviour.
findings.evidence: grep -n 'strncmp(fb.dir, "mc", 2)' src/dash_browser.c: 2794, 2816, 2818, 2821, 2823, 2864, 2870, 2879, 2883; grep -n 'strncmp(.*"mass", 4)': 1818, 1912, 2067, 2332; 'mc0:", 4)': 299, 364, 3437. fb.dir is not changed inside actionsMenu before the switch.

findings.title: File-type extension lists and size formatting written several times in dash_browser.c
findings.problem: fileIcon re-tests ELF/KELF/XLF (also in fbFileType 213 and activate 773) and PNG/JPG/JPEG (isImageFile 125-127); the ELF/XLF/KELF/VCD/ISO/CUE launchable list is spelled out in activate and again in actionsMenu 2778-2780. fmtSize recomputes fbFileBytes (174-177) and repeats fmtBytes' GB/MB branches; opSize has a third GB/MB formatter. ps1SaveTargets loops with a hard-coded 6 instead of the array size.
findings.fix: Have fileIcon use fbFileType and isImageFile; use one static isLaunchableExt() in activate and actionsMenu; make fmtSize call fbFileBytes and fmtBytes; use the array size in ps1SaveTargets. tests/test_zack_launch_sizing.py and test_png_viewer.py grep these functions.
findings.justification: isLaunchableExt replaces two copies of the same six-extension test; it removes lines overall.
findings.benefit: ~15 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges)
findings.evidence: Read all cited ranges; fbFileBytes body 176 equals fmtSize 3207; fmtBytes 3199-3202 equals fmtSize 3211-3214; grep '%.2f GB' src: dash_browser.c 1200, 3200, 3212 only.

findings.title: Small leftovers: duplicate prototype, unused include, unreachable SAME_PATH branch, redundant copies and branches
findings.problem: IsTextEditorFileType is re-declared at 31 although launchelf.h:404 (via dash_internal.h) declares it; gui_sort.h (cmpFile, sort) is included but nothing from it is used; nextImageIndex wraps by hand instead of using wrapIndex; opRename copies the name into want_sel although openDir(fb.dir, name) overwrites it; the MC_CARD_EXPORT_SAME_PATH branch is unreachable because 1697 already rejected the same strcmp-equal paths; recoverCardFromPath copies the non-const stage[] into clean[] before genRemove; both bookmark branches at 2678-2681 append '/' (one test on '/' suffices).
findings.fix: Delete line 31, the gui_sort.h include, line 1139, the SAME_PATH branch, the clean[] copy (pass stage) and the second bookmark branch; use wrapIndex in nextImageIndex.
findings.evidence: grep IsTextEditorFileType: launchelf.h:404, main_fileops.c:56 def; dash_internal.h:12 includes launchelf.h. grep 'cmpFile\|[^a-zA-Z_]sort(' dash_browser.c: none. openDir 480-482 resets and copies want_sel. mc_card_export.c:386 returns SAME_PATH only on !strcmp(source,dest); mcCardBackupNoEcc at 353. genRemove(char *) at filer_fileops.c:259; stage is char[MAX_PATH] at 2210.

findings.title: tsChoose never shows its fifth detail string (Tuna Date)
findings.problem: details[] has five entries, the fifth being "set selected MC folder to 2099", but the loop uses i < 4 ? details[i] : NULL, so the *Tuna Date row (passed as the fifth label when allow_tuna is set, filer_actions.c:1406-1415) never gets its detail and the string is dead.
findings.fix: Use the array size instead of 4 (or delete the fifth string if the row should stay bare).
findings.benefit: Trivial UI fix or a few bytes of dead .rodata (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read dash_browser.c 2401-2416 and filer_actions.c 1405-1429: items[] has 5 labels, count = TIMESTAMP_ORGANIZE_COUNT when allow_tuna, passed to filerTimestampUi->choose = tsChoose (dash_timestamp_ui at 2538).

findings.title: opExtractPsuTo repeats opCopy's clipboard fill and the 'clipboard was cleared' toast three times
findings.problem: Both functions reserve the clipboard with the same error modal and then set clipPath, clipFiles, nclipFiles, browser_cut and clipIopResetGeneration with identical lines; opExtractPsuTo then emits the same clipboard_lost toast on three exit paths.
findings.fix: Move the reserve-and-fill into one static helper used by both, and restructure the end of opExtractPsuTo so the clipboard_lost toast is emitted once.
findings.justification: The helper replaces two copies of the same ~9 lines and removes code overall.
findings.evidence: Read 820-850 and 976-1048; lines 837-842 and 1007-1012 assign the same globals from fb.files[idx[i]]; 1031-1032, 1037-1038, 1046-1047 are the same toast.
